semiconductor_relevance: High — Frontier Semiconductor specializes in advanced metrology solutions for semiconductor applications, making it a key player in the equipment segment.
summary: Frontier Semiconductor provides a comprehensive range of metrology tools and solutions tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, and other high-tech applications. Their offerings include systems for measuring wafer thickness, film stress, and total thickness variation, supporting various temperature ranges and process conditions.
capabilities: Wafer thickness and TSV depth measurement tools
Film stress measurement tools up to 900°C
Nanoscale topography and roughness measurement systems
